name: How much do accessibility-minded bathroom modifications typically cost in the East Bay area?

mainEntity.name: How much do accessibility-minded bathroom modifications typically cost in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of accessibility-minded bathroom modifications in the East Bay area varies widely depending on the scope of work. Minor changes like grab bar installation might be a few hundred dollars. Larger projects, such as a full bathroom remodel with a curbless shower and wider doorways, can range from several thousand to tens of thousands of dollars. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to understand your specific needs and the existing bathroom layout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on the project's scope, from a few hundred dollars for minor changes to tens of thousands for full remodels.
